purpose: Replay the frozen KAN-19 policy over validation windows at several N and lease values, and record what each costs in false quarantine, blocked time and detection delay. Fixed before the run.

frozen_policy.note: The KAN-19 operating artifact is loaded and its hashes verified; the threshold is never recomputed.

evaluated_on: the seed-1 validation split only: benign Honeypot-5-1 and malware Malware-8-1
never: score the development pack's test split (7-1, 3-1)
retrain, re-threshold or replace the frozen model
present FPR^N as a false-quarantine probability

replay.rearm: after every lease expiry the episode is re-armed, as an operator or reconcile step would; without it a device could be quarantined at most once and the rate would be capped by construction
replay.gaps: windows are replayed in order per device; a non-contiguous window is a gap and DevicePolicy resets the series, which is the declared baseline

reported_per_cell: benign device: quarantine episodes, false quarantines per observed device-hour, blocked seconds per observed device-hour
malware device: whether the incident was detected, delay from the first malicious window to the quarantine decision, contained fraction of observed malicious time, number of re-quarantines
both: observed windows, observed device-hours, policy rejection and reset counters

selection_rule.n: the smallest N with zero quarantine episodes on the benign validation capture
selection_rule.lease: among the qualifying N, the smallest lease whose blocked share of observed malicious time, measured as interval overlap, is at least containment_floor
selection_rule.if_none: report that no cell qualifies and choose nothing; the budget is never relaxed to produce a pick
selection_rule.status: Lead, 20 September 2026, first-hand on PR #44: N = 2 supported as the provisional validation choice; no lease approved and the holdout stays sealed until the corrected result is reviewed.

limits: One benign device and one malware capture: a rate per device-hour from a single device is an observation, not a population estimate.
Replay assumes each window is decided 0.5 s after it closes; real capture and inference delay is measured in KAN-42, not here.
Blocked seconds are policy intent. Whether traffic actually stopped is KAN-33/KAN-52 evidence.
Consecutive windows are not independent, so no cell's false-quarantine rate is derived from the window FPR.

revision.reason: R3 review of PR #44. The 0.9 floor already declared in selection_rule.lease at 104b2e4 becomes the validated numeric field containment_floor, and the lease criterion is stated as interval overlap rather than a comparison of totals. The grid, the frozen policy, the replay settings and the floor value are unchanged.
